title: Requests to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 will fail after the November 30, 2026 retirement
symptoms: Requests pinned to claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929 start returning errors after November 30, 2026
Model not found style errors in production with no code change
cause: Claude Sonnet 4.5 was deprecated on September 30, 2026, and retirement on the Claude API is scheduled for November 30, 2026. Pinned model IDs stop working on that date.
fix: Move to claude-sonnet-5-5 before the date. Sonnet 5.5 has its own breaking changes: use thinking type between_tools instead of disabled, drop tool_choice any and tool, and use the newer computer use toolset. Test before switching.
